CRM notes (sales + eng):

- Integration asks: support for bulk embedding jobs (API for batching + async callbacks), native export to pgvector, connectors to S3 for large ingestion.
- Engineering asks: kernel/quantization tradeoffs — want to see quality delta at 4-bit quant for faster perf.
- Next steps: finalize POC perf tuning (batch sizing, caching), run second Dedicated trial with recommended batching & KV cache settings, then deliver pricing for 3-node reserved capacity + optional HA replica.
